author: Bobby Grayson
description: docs/readiness.md now carries the ten nearest untranslatable modules. Distance 1: Loom.LSP.ConfigListener (one blocker: one call into Loom.LSP.Supervisor). Distance 2: BobsBroadcastWeb.StreamController, EnsembleWeb.LogsLive, Loom.Session.Architect, Loom.Tools.Shell, LoomWeb.CostDashboardLive, EnsembleWeb.DecisionGraphLive. Distance 3: Ensemble.AI.TextGenerator, BobsBroadcastWeb.RadioLive, Ensemble.IssueOrchestrator. Six of the top seven share one family, 'no @type state and no init/1 to infer one from': untyped mode reads the state from init/1's literal and these modules have no init/1 at all. Three of those six need one other thing each, and it is the same one twice: 'receive not the whole body of a one-argument def' (a receive nested inside a larger function). Those two families alone would move the count from 1 translatable module to about 4.
title: Planning input for round 8, from the new closest-to-translatable table
